name: Othniel
bio: Othniel was the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother. Caleb promised that whoever captured the city of Kiriath Sepher (Debir) would receive his daughter Achsah as his wife; Othniel took the city and married Achsah (Joshua 15:16-17). After Israel settled in Canaan, they gradually intermarried with the local peoples and worshiped foreign gods, and the LORD's anger subjected them to eight years of oppression under Cushan-Rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia. When the people cried out, the LORD raised up Othniel as their deliverer; the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went out to war and gave Cushan-Rishathaim into his hand, bringing the land forty years of peace. Othniel became the first of Israel's judges, setting the pattern for the deliverers who would be raised up generation after generation, and he lived to old age before he died (Judges 3:7-11).
